full_disk_encryption_enabled.title: Full Disk Encryption Enabled
full_disk_encryption_enabled.description: Indicates whether full-disk or volume-level encryption is enabled and active on the device (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS, or equivalent).

encryption_scope.title: Encryption Scope
encryption_scope.description: Describes the extent of disk encryption coverage: full (all volumes/partitions encrypted), partial (only select partitions encrypted), or none (no encryption applied).

screen_lock_enabled.title: Screen Lock Enabled
screen_lock_enabled.description: Whether a screen lock (PIN, password, pattern, or biometric) is enforced on the device when idle or after a timeout.

screen_lock_type.title: Screen Lock Authentication Type
screen_lock_type.description: The type of credential used to unlock the device screen.

minimum_passcode_length.title: Minimum Passcode Length
minimum_passcode_length.description: The minimum number of characters or digits required for the device screen lock passcode/PIN as enforced by policy.

biometric_fallback_factor.title: Biometric Fallback Authentication Factor
biometric_fallback_factor.description: The fallback authentication method available when biometric authentication fails or is bypassed.

standard_users_have_local_admin.title: Standard Users Granted Local Administrator Privileges
standard_users_have_local_admin.description: Indicates whether standard (non-IT) end users are members of the local Administrators group on their devices, granting persistent elevated privileges.

privileged_access_management_enforced.title: Privileged Access Management (PAM) or Least Privilege Tool Enforced
privileged_access_management_enforced.description: Indicates whether a privileged access management solution (e.g., just-in-time elevation, application allow-listing with elevation) is deployed and active, replacing persistent local admin rights.

endpoint_protection_status.title: Endpoint Protection Status
endpoint_protection_status.description: Operational status of antivirus, EDR, or host-based IPS on the device.

signature_age_days.title: Signature / Definition Age (Days)
signature_age_days.description: Number of days since the endpoint protection software last successfully updated its threat signature or definition database.

broad_exclusion_paths.title: Broad Endpoint Protection Exclusion Paths
broad_exclusion_paths.description: List of filesystem paths or path patterns configured as scan/detection exclusions in the endpoint protection tool that are considered overly broad.

days_since_critical_patch_available.title: Days Since Critical Patch Available
days_since_critical_patch_available.description: Number of days elapsed since the most recent critical OS, driver, or firmware patch was released by the vendor without the device having applied it.

patch_scope.title: Unpatched Critical Patch Scope
patch_scope.description: List of component types with outstanding critical patches not yet applied on the device. Possible elements: 'os', 'driver', 'uefi_bios'.

secure_boot_enabled.title: Secure Boot Enabled
secure_boot_enabled.description: Whether UEFI Secure Boot is enabled on the device, preventing execution of unsigned or untrusted bootloaders and OS loaders.

secure_boot_custom_db_state.title: Secure Boot Custom Key Database State
secure_boot_custom_db_state.description: Indicates whether the Secure Boot signature database contains only Microsoft/OEM-trusted certificates, has been extended with custom certificates, or has been replaced with untrusted/unknown certificates.

mdm_enrollment_status.title: MDM/UEM Enrollment Status
mdm_enrollment_status.description: Whether the device is enrolled in a Mobile Device Management or Unified Endpoint Management solution, and whether compliance is actively enforced.

byod_policy_enforced.title: BYOD Policy Enforcement Active
byod_policy_enforced.description: Whether a formal BYOD policy with conditional access controls is actively enforced, blocking unenrolled personal devices from accessing corporate resources.

remote_wipe_capability_available.title: Remote Wipe Capability Available
remote_wipe_capability_available.description: Whether IT has the ability to remotely wipe or selectively wipe corporate data from the device in the event of loss, theft, or termination.

plaintext_credential_files_found.title: Plaintext Credential Files Detected
plaintext_credential_files_found.description: Whether credential files (e.g., .env, config.ini, credentials.txt, private keys) containing plaintext passwords, API keys, or tokens exist in user-accessible directories on the device.

browser_master_password_enforced.title: Browser Master Password Enforced
browser_master_password_enforced.description: Whether the browser's saved password store is protected by a master password or OS-level credential protection equivalent, preventing unauthenticated access to stored credentials.

os_credential_manager_protection_enabled.title: OS Credential Manager Protection Enabled
os_credential_manager_protection_enabled.description: Whether the operating system's credential manager (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service/gnome-keyring) is actively protecting stored credentials with encryption tied to authenticated user sessions.

host_firewall_enabled.title: Host Firewall Enabled
host_firewall_enabled.description: Whether the OS-level host firewall (e.g., Windows Defender Firewall, iptables/ufw on Linux, pf on macOS) is currently enabled and active.

inbound_default_policy.title: Inbound Default Firewall Policy
inbound_default_policy.description: The default action applied to inbound connections not matched by an explicit rule.

usb_storage_policy.title: USB Storage Device Policy
usb_storage_policy.description: The enforcement policy applied to USB mass storage devices on the endpoint — whether they are blocked, restricted (read-only or allow-listed), or unrestricted.

removable_media_audit_enabled.title: Removable Media Audit Logging Enabled
removable_media_audit_enabled.description: Whether connection, read, and write events for removable media devices are logged and forwarded to a centralized audit system.

device_control_tool_deployed.title: Device Control Tool Deployed
device_control_tool_deployed.description: Whether a dedicated device control solution (e.g., endpoint DLP agent, MDM device restriction profile, or GPO-based device class blocking) is actively deployed and enforced on the endpoint.

log_forwarding_enabled.title: Log Forwarding Enabled
log_forwarding_enabled.description: Whether endpoint device logs (authentication, process execution, network connections) are configured to forward to a central SIEM or log aggregator.

siem_last_event_age_hours.title: Hours Since Last Event Received by SIEM
siem_last_event_age_hours.description: Number of hours since the SIEM or log aggregator last received an event from this endpoint. A high value indicates log forwarding may be broken or disabled.

log_tamper_protection_enabled.title: Local Log Tamper Protection Enabled
log_tamper_protection_enabled.description: Whether local logs are protected against tampering or deletion by non-privileged processes (e.g., log files have restricted permissions, tamper protection is enabled on the EDR agent, or write-once log storage is configured).

auto_connect_to_open_networks_enabled.title: Auto-Connect to Open Networks Enabled
auto_connect_to_open_networks_enabled.description: Whether the device is configured to automatically connect to open (unsecured) Wi-Fi networks without user confirmation.

auto_reconnect_to_known_networks_enabled.title: Auto-Reconnect to Previously Seen Networks Enabled
auto_reconnect_to_known_networks_enabled.description: Whether the device automatically reconnects to any previously joined network by SSID match alone, without requiring additional validation such as certificate checking, making it vulnerable to evil-twin attacks.

wifi_security_policy_enforced_via_mdm.title: Wi-Fi Security Policy Enforced via MDM
wifi_security_policy_enforced_via_mdm.description: Whether a mobile device management (MDM) policy is actively enforced that restricts auto-join behavior and prohibits connections to open or untrusted Wi-Fi networks.

software_allowlisting_enforced.title: Software Allowlisting Enforced
software_allowlisting_enforced.description: Indicates whether an application allowlisting/whitelisting control (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC, Gatekeeper, SELinux policy) is actively enforced on the endpoint, preventing execution of unapproved software.

it_approved_software_policy_exists.title: IT-Approved Software Policy Exists and Is Enforced
it_approved_software_policy_exists.description: Indicates whether a documented and technically enforced software approval/vetting policy exists that requires IT sign-off before installation, backed by a managed software catalog or MDM-level restriction.

endpoint_admin_rights_scope.title: Endpoint User Admin Rights Scope
endpoint_admin_rights_scope.description: Describes the level of administrative privilege granted to the end user on their device, which directly controls whether they can self-install arbitrary software.

nac_or_conditional_access_enabled.title: NAC or Conditional Access Policy Enabled
nac_or_conditional_access_enabled.description: Whether a network access control system or conditional access policy is actively enforced to gate corporate application or VPN access.

device_health_checks_enforced.title: Device Health Posture Checks Enforced
device_health_checks_enforced.description: Whether the NAC or conditional access policy actively verifies device health signals (patch level, disk encryption status, EDR health) as a condition of granting access.

non_compliant_device_action.title: Action Taken for Non-Compliant Devices
non_compliant_device_action.description: The enforcement action applied when a device fails health posture checks.
